stem: In her Science class, Meera learns that her body is organised in levels: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism. Her heart is made of muscle tissue and pumps blood around her body. In this sequence of levels, the heart is best described as an:

teacher.key_rationale: The heart is a structure made of different tissues working together to perform one function (pumping blood), so it is an organ. Organ system (A) is the trap for students who jump one level too high because the heart belongs to the circulatory system; tissue (B) is one level too low.
